recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-36942 unless the work group later changes the all-codes policy or wants additional normative detail about valid compositions.
issue_request: FHIR-36942 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab clarification for R5 asking whether a ValueSet.compose include that names only a code system includes retired codes and valid code system compositions. The resolution says all concepts defined by the code system are included independent of concept status, including retired concepts known to the terminology service, and valid code system compositions are members when the code system supports compositions.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 27b184d04790893f6ff56757454031e29bf64ff9, which changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml from 'All codes in the system are included' to 'All codes defined by the code system, independent of code status, are included.'
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and the valueset notes source contains the Composition Rules narrative. The companion Published issue FHIR-36837 used the FHIR-36942 resolution for CodeSystem.valueSet all-codes wording, Vocab minutes from 2022-04-28 list both issues for review/vote, and an archived Vocab policy page repeats the same all-codes-independent-of-status concept. Zulip searches found no direct conflicting discussion for FHIR-36942.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml already contains the requested clarification and is in the current build scope through the active ValueSet resource configuration.
